items.title: Section: Psychic Power's Fruit — One Body Becomes Many, Walls Become Nothing

items.zh: 由此五想修習成滿，領受種種妙神境通。或從一身示現多身，謂由現化勝解想故；或從多身示現一身，謂由隱化勝解想故；或以其身，於諸牆壁、垣城等類厚障隔事直過無礙；或於其地出沒如水；或於其水斷流往返，履上如地；或如飛鳥，結加趺坐，騰颺虛空；或於廣大威德勢力日月光輪，以手捫摸；或以其身，乃至梵世自在迴轉。
items.en: Through cultivating and thoroughly perfecting these five perceptions, one receives various forms of wondrous psychic power. One may manifest many bodies from a single body — this is through the confident-understanding perception of manifesting; or manifest a single body from many bodies — this is through the confident-understanding perception of concealing; or, with one's own body, pass directly and without obstruction through walls, ramparts, city walls, and other such thick, obstructing barriers; or sink into and emerge from the earth as though it were water; or cut off the flow of water and walk back and forth upon it as though upon solid ground; or, cross-legged like a bird in flight, soar aloft through open space; or touch, with the hand, the sun and moon's disks of vast and majestic power; or, with one's own body, freely move about all the way to the Brahmā world.

items.zh: 當知如是種種神變，皆由輕舉、柔軟、空界、身心符順想所攝受勝解想故，隨其所應，一切能作。此中以身於其梵世，略有二種自在迴轉。一者、往來自在迴轉；二、於梵世諸四大種一分造色，如其所樂，隨勝解力，自在迴轉。先所受行次第隨念想者，謂由此想，從童子位迄至于今，隨憶念轉，自在無礙。隨彼彼位，若行、若住、若坐、若臥，廣說一切先所受行，隨其麁略，次第無越，憶念了知，於此修習、多修習故，證得修果，於無量種宿世所住，廣說乃至所有行相、所有宣說，皆能隨念。

items.title: The Remaining Three Superknowledges: Ear, Eye, and Reading Others' Minds

items.zh: 種種品類集會音聲想者，謂由此想，遍於彼彼村邑、聚落，或長者眾、或邑義眾、或餘大眾、或廣長處、或家、或室，種種品類諸眾集會所出種種雜類音聲、名諠譟聲，或於大河眾流激湍波浪音聲，善取其相。以修所成定地作意，於諸天人，若遠、若近，聖、非聖聲，力勵聽採。於此修習、多修習故，證得修果清淨天耳，由是能聞人間、天上，若遠、若近，一切音聲。
items.en: The perception of the manifold, massed sounds of a gathering: by means of this perception … one exerts effort to listen and take in the sounds of gods and humans, far or near, noble or ordinary. Through cultivating and thoroughly cultivating this, one attains as its fruit the purified heavenly ear, and by means of it is able to hear every sound in the human realm and the heavens, far or near.

items.zh: 光明色相想者，謂於如前所說種種諸光明相，極善取已，即於彼相作意思惟。又於種種諸有情類善不善等業用差別，善取其相，即於彼相作意思惟，是名光明色相想。於此修習、多修習故，證得修果死生智通，由是清淨天眼通故，見諸有情，廣說乃至身壞已後，往生善趣天世間中。
items.en: The perception of light and visible appearance: taking hold, most thoroughly, of the various kinds of light already described, one attends and reflects upon exactly that mark … through cultivating and thoroughly cultivating this, one attains as its fruit the knowledge of death and rebirth; by means of this purified heavenly eye, one sees where beings, described in full down to the very moment the body breaks apart, go on to be reborn — in a fortunate destiny, a heavenly world, or elsewhere.

items.zh: 煩惱所作色變異想者，謂由此想，於貪、恚、癡、忿、恨、覆、惱、誑、諂、慳、嫉，及以憍、害、無慚、無愧諸餘煩惱及隨煩惱纏繞其心諸有情類，種種色位色相變異，解了分別。如是色類有貪欲者，有色分位、色相變異，謂諸根躁擾、諸根掉舉，言常含笑。如是色類有瞋恚者，有色分位、色相變異，謂面恒顰蹙，語音謇澁，言常變色。如是色類有愚癡者，有色分位、色相變異，謂多分瘖瘂，事義闇昧，言不辯了，語多下里。由如是等行相流類，廣說乃至無慚愧等所纏繞者，有色分位、色相變異，善取其相，復於彼相作意思惟。於此修習、多修習故，發生修果心差別智，由此智故，於他有情補特伽羅隨所尋思、隨所伺察心、意、識等，皆如實知。
items.en: The perception of the bodily transformations produced by affliction: by means of this perception, with respect to beings whose minds are bound by craving, hatred, delusion … one comes to understand and discern the manifold changing states and marks of the body. Through cultivating and thoroughly cultivating this, one gives rise, as its fruit, to the knowledge of discerning others' minds; by means of this knowledge, whatever a given being reflects upon or examines — their mind, their intellect, their consciousness — one knows exactly as it truly is.

items.title: Section: Noble Superknowledge vs. Ordinary — and the Deeper Powers Wisdom Adds

items.en: Furthermore, the psychic power of a noble one and of one who is not noble differ in this respect: a noble one's superknowledge, in whatever it transforms, whatever it conjures, whatever it confidently understands, is able in every case to genuinely accomplish it, without reverting or changing, fit and usable for its purpose. The superknowledge of one who is not noble cannot do this — it is like an illusion, fit only to be looked at, not fit for actual use.

items.zh: 前三摩呬多地，應知修相。
由於此想親近、修習、多修習故，能引最勝諸聖神通，若變事通、若化事通、若勝解通。及能引發無諍、願智、四無礙解。謂法無礙解、義無礙解、辭無礙解、辯無礙解等種種功德。
items.en: By closely cultivating and thoroughly cultivating these perceptions, one is able to give rise to the most excellent superknowledges of the noble ones — the superknowledge of transformation, the superknowledge of conjuring, and the superknowledge of confident understanding — and is further able to give rise to freedom from contention, wish-fulfilling wisdom, and the four unimpeded understandings: the unimpeded understanding of the teaching, of its meaning, of its expression, and of eloquence, and other such manifold virtues.

items.zh: 又聖、非聖二神境通有差別者，謂聖神通，隨所變事、隨所化事、隨所勝解，一切皆能如實成辦，無有改異，堪任有用。非聖神通不能如是，猶如幻化，唯可觀見，不堪受用。當知如是十二種想，親近、修習、多修習故，隨其所應，便能引發五種神通，及能引發不共異生如其所應諸聖功德。

blocks.text: What the perceptions produce, and the difference between a noble one's powers and an ordinary practitioner's. Two short passages are untranslated.
"One may manifest many bodies from a single body, or one body from many; pass through walls; cut off the flow of water and walk on it as on solid ground." Venerable Miào Jìng comments on each.
Through the perception of "the manifold, massed sounds of a gathering", listening to the sounds of gods and humans, near or far, one attains "the purified divine ear".
Through the perception of light and visible appearance, one attains the knowledge of death and rebirth (the divine eye) and the recollection of past lives.

Through perceiving "the bodily transformations produced by affliction", the changes in the bodies of those bound by craving, hatred, delusion, one learns to know "their mind, their intellect, their consciousness".

"A noble one's superknowledge, in whatever it transforms or conjures, genuinely accomplishes it, without reverting. The superknowledge of one who is not noble cannot: it is like an illusion, fit only to be looked at." Noble ones further develop freedom from contention, wish-fulfilling knowledge, and the four unimpeded understandings.

quiz.q: "One body becomes many; many become one." How does Venerable Miào Jìng distinguish them?
options: few to many is manifesting, many to few is concealing
quiz.why: "One may manifest many bodies from a single body — through the confident-understanding perception of manifesting; or manifest a single body from many — through that of concealing." Venerable Miào Jìng: few to many is manifesting; many to few is concealing.

quiz.q: "Walking on water as on land" — the masters tell of the Buddha crossing a river. Why would the Buddha take a boat?
options: Miào Jìng: to let the boatman gain merit; Cháng Bǎi: the boatman wanted payment, so the Buddha declined — offered merit, he refused
quiz.why: "Or cut off the flow of water and walk back and forth upon it as though upon solid ground." Venerable Miào Jìng: why take a boat? Really to give him merit — carrying the Buddha across earns merit! Master Cháng Bǎi: the boatman wanted money; the Buddha said, then I won't ride — offered the chance for merit, he refused.

quiz.q: Attaining "the purified heavenly ear" — what if one hears sounds but not meaning, according to Venerable Miào Jìng?
options: hearing sound without meaning — how is that different from lacking the heavenly ear?
quiz.why: "One attains as its fruit the purified heavenly ear, and by means of it is able to hear every sound in the human realm and the heavens, far or near." Venerable Miào Jìng: if one only hears the sound but doesn't know the meaning, how is that different from us who lack the heavenly ear?

quiz.q: For the heavenly eye, "the perception of light and appearance." What two kinds of light does Venerable Miào Jìng distinguish?
options: first outer light; skilfully grasping wholesome and unwholesome karma's marks is wisdom's light
quiz.why: "The perception of light and visible appearance: taking hold, most thoroughly, of the various kinds of light already described, one attends and reflects upon exactly that mark." Venerable Miào Jìng: earlier was outer light; skilfully grasping the marks of wholesome and unwholesome karma — that is wisdom's light.

quiz.q: Knowledge of other minds knows their "心, 意, 識." How does Master Cháng Bǎi map these?
options: 心 is the eighth, 意 the seventh, 識 the first six — all known
quiz.why: "Whatever a given being reflects upon or examines — their mind, their intellect, their consciousness — one knows exactly as it truly is." Master Cháng Bǎi: one penetrates the eighth consciousness as 心, the seventh as 意, and the six active consciousnesses.

quiz.q: Non-noble powers are "like illusion, only to be looked at, not used." What does Venerable Miào Jìng say?
options: only for the eyes — touch it and it isn't there
quiz.why: "The superknowledge of one who is not noble cannot do this — it is like an illusion, fit only to be looked at, not fit for actual use." Venerable Miào Jìng: "only to be looked at" — you can only see it; actually touch it and it's not there.

quiz.q: Noble powers give rise to "freedom from contention." How does Venerable Miào Jìng explain it?
options: not letting oneself cause others' affliction
quiz.why: "And is further able to give rise to freedom from contention, wish-fulfilling wisdom, and the four unimpeded understandings." Venerable Miào Jìng: this is called the samādhi of non-contention — not letting afflictions arise because of me.
